title: China-to-North Macedonia Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Solar Inverter EMI, EMC, and Anti-Islanding Behavior
rows.target_requirement: North Macedonia projects commonly require both EMC compliance and anti-islanding logic for grid-connected solar inverters. IEC 61000-6 series emissions and immunity evidence and IEC 62116/IEC 62109 protective behavior are relevant where the model is supplied into public low-voltage networks; required settings and accepted routes must be confirmed against ERC and MEPSO project expectations.
rows.china_equivalent: China inverter baselines commonly use GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964 test evidence for grid behavior and protection checks. Those reports can support technical comparison but do not replace North Macedonia route-specific EMC evidence, anti-islanding settings, and project-commissioning checks.
china_standards: China inverter grid-compliance and EMC test evidence
rows.gap: The gap is complete country profile control. Exporters should map North Macedonia-specific voltage/frequency windows, over/under-voltage and frequency protections, anti-islanding test reports, and EMC installation assumptions against project commissioning evidence rather than assuming default China profiles are accepted.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where project grid-connection routes require EMC/anti-islanding behavior and project commissioning evidence
mandatory_status.cn: China GB/T evidence supports engineering comparison only and is not North Macedonia approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not reuse default China anti-islanding and EMC profiles for North Macedonia deployment without a project-level Turkish-like route check adapted to ERC and MEPSO expectations.

rows.target_requirement: North Macedonia distributed solar projects may proceed under ERC framework rules where project scope qualifies, but the inverter is still reviewed in the project grid-connection file by the relevant distribution company and MEPSO-related technical acceptance process. Product test reports do not replace connection opinion, project approval, protection settings, metering, commissioning, or acceptance documents.
target_standards: North Macedonia electricity market and distributed generation framework administered by ERC
MEPSO and distribution-company project connection and acceptance practices
rows.china_equivalent: China State Grid, China Southern Power Grid, GB/T 19964-2024, and GB/T 37408 documentation can support technical comparisons, but North Macedonia connection approval depends on local project, distribution company, ERC framework, and MEPSO-related acceptance route.
china_standards: State Grid / China Southern Power Grid project procedures
rows.gap: The gap is North Macedonia project acceptance. Exporters should prepare single-line diagrams, inverter model certificates, protection setting tables, grid-code parameter ranges, reactive-power capability, remote-control or monitoring interface evidence, metering and communication compatibility, commissioning records, and Turkish-corridor-ready operations documentation for the receiving project owner and utility.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for projects that seek North Macedonia grid connection under licensed or unlicensed renewable-generation pathways; acceptance is project- and distribution-company-specific
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China grid approval does not transfer to North Macedonia ERC / MEPSO project approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat North Macedonia ERC/MEPSO grid connection as a project approval path separate from product CE or GB/T testing; Chinese grid evidence should not be presented as North Macedonia interconnection approval.

rows.requirement: EN 62109 Safety Evidence for PV Inverter Power Converters
rows.target_requirement: North Macedonia follows ISRSM-adopted EN and IEC standards through its EU-candidate alignment. For PV inverter safety, EN 62109-1 and EN 62109-2 evidence is commonly the relevant product-safety baseline, but legal impact depends on applicable North Macedonia technical regulation, customer tender, utility list, or project approval route.
rows.china_equivalent: China inverter documentation may include GB/T 37408 and grid-code reports, plus voluntary CGC/CQC or IEC reports. GB/T evidence alone does not by itself prove conformity to the full EN 62109 construction, thermal, insulation, marking, and abnormal-operation requirements.
china_standards: Voluntary CQC / CGC / IEC test reports where available
rows.gap: The gap is whether the safety file is built around EN/IEC 62109 and accepted in the North Macedonia route. Exporters should prepare CB/IEC or EN 62109 reports, component critical list, thermal derating data, DC input limits, fault test evidence, North Macedonia-language user warnings, and nameplate data aligned to the exact model family.

mandatory_status.target: Voluntary as a standard unless incorporated by an applicable North Macedonia technical regulation, utility/project rule, tender, or conformity route; often practically required as accepted safety evidence
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China GB/T inverter evidence does not automatically satisfy EN 62109 safety evidence

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not treat EN 62109 as a blanket statutory certificate without route confirmation, but prepare EN/IEC 62109 safety evidence because North Macedonia buyers, utilities, and conformity files commonly expect it.

source.publisher: Standardization Institute of the Republic of North Macedonia (ISRSM)
